items.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.en_title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.en_oneliner: Google has added Tool Retrieval to the Gemini API in preview, letting agents keep a large tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when needed, cutting input tokens while keeping tool selection accurate.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Gemini and Tools · Published within 6 hours

items.en_oneliner: Version 2.1.329 adds two safety prompts for hook configuration: the dialog now shows which folder a hook is declared in, and non-interactive hosts also flag hooks from managed settings.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Claude · Published within 6 hours

items.en_oneliner: In Claude Code 2.1.328, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 gain an automatic mode across Bedrock, Google Cloud, Foundry, and the apps gateway, and interactive sessions that skip permission prompts now begin there.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Claude and Agent · Published within 24 hours

items.title: LangSmith Tool Gateway: Secure, governed tool use for agents
items.en_title: LangSmith Tool Gateway: Secure, governed tool use for agents
items.en_oneliner: Now in public beta, LangSmith's Tool Gateway centralizes credential, identity, and access handling for agent tool calls, adding policy controls, approval flows, and trace visibility.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Agent and Tools · Published within 24 hours

items.title: v2.71.0 (2026-11-18)
items.en_oneliner: Pydantic AI 2.71.0 is out, with changes to how multi-agent peer networks connect and how their interfaces are named, plus support for a new model provider, Stav.

items.title: Devin for Databricks Migrations: Less time migrating, more time building
items.en_title: Devin for Databricks Migrations: Less time migrating, more time building
items.en_oneliner: A new Devin–Databricks collaboration speeds enterprise migrations away from legacy data platforms, so engineers can focus their time on building with data.
